Class PhaseManager

java.lang.Object
backend.logic.PhaseManager
public class PhaseManager extends Object
Coordinates attack and defend phase flow for a Typing Duel match.

This class tracks the active PhaseManager.GamePhase, manages player and opponent health, applies queued PhaseManager.PowerUp effects, and resolves the combat result of a completed typing phase. It centralizes the mode-independent match rules so controllers can drive gameplay without embedding combat calculations in the GUI layer.

In standard play, successful attack phases damage the opponent and failed defend phases damage the player. In endless mode, the same phase structure is preserved, but opponent depletion is skipped so combat can continue across an unlimited number of waves.

Design Documentation Section 5.4; FR 3.5.

Team 49 - CS2212B Winter 2026

  • Constructor Details

    • PhaseManager

      public PhaseManager(TypingEngine engine)
      Creates a phase manager for a new match.

      The manager starts in PhaseManager.GamePhase.ATTACK with both combatants at full health and no active power-up.

      Parameters:
      engine - the typing engine associated with the active game session

    • resolvePhaseEffect

      public void resolvePhaseEffect(boolean isSuccessful, int wordPointValue, boolean isEndlessMode)
      Resolves the current phase and applies any HP changes caused by the outcome.

      This convenience method performs the same state updates as resolvePhaseEffectDetailed(boolean, int, boolean) but discards the detailed result object when the caller only needs side effects.

      Parameters:
      isSuccessful - whether the player completed the word before time expired
      wordPointValue - the word's base value, used as damage during resolution
      isEndlessMode - whether endless-mode combat rules should be applied

    • resolvePhaseEffectDetailed

      public PhaseManager.PhaseResolution resolvePhaseEffectDetailed(boolean isSuccessful, int wordPointValue, boolean isEndlessMode)
      Resolves the current phase and returns a detailed summary of the outcome.

      The active power-up is consumed after this method runs, regardless of whether the player succeeded or failed.

      Parameters:
      isSuccessful - whether the player completed the word before time expired
      wordPointValue - the word's base value, used as damage during resolution
      isEndlessMode - whether endless-mode combat rules should be applied
      Returns:
      an immutable summary of the resolved phase outcome
